name: dividend-data
description: Fundamentals, KPIs, prices, valuation, earnings and dividends for 80,000+ stocks and funds.

interface.longDescription:
Dividend Data connects your AI assistant to the research terminal at DividendData.com, covering more than 80,000 stocks, ETFs, mutual funds and closed-end funds worldwide. Answers carry the numbers the site shows, each linked to its page so you can check it.

Ask about:
- Financial statements: income, balance sheet and cash flow, annual or quarterly, every line item, plus margins, returns on capital and debt maturities.
- Company KPIs: segment results and operating metrics from each company's own SEC filings, every value linked to its source.
- Prices: daily split-adjusted price history, total return and market cap, with splits.
- Valuation: current and historical multiples, analyst ratings and price targets, valuation against a stock's own history, and fair value from four intrinsic value models.
- Earnings: EPS as announced and as filed, consensus estimates, the earnings calendar and earnings call transcripts.
- Dividends: payment history, yield, growth, payout ratios and the Dividend Safety grade, plus the dividend calendar and dividend announcements with their source documents.
- Funds: costs, holdings, sector and country mix, distributions and lower-cost alternatives.
- Discovery: leaderboards, curated lists, a stock screener with more than 40 metrics, supply chain maps, and the holdings of well-known investors and other tracked strategies.
- Charts: any Chart Builder chart, returned as a link and an image.
- Your account: your watchlist and portfolio. If you turn on Allow Changes in your Dividend Data settings, your assistant can add tickers to a watchlist and holdings to a manual portfolio account when you ask. It cannot remove anything, trade or move money.

Some features depend on your Dividend Data plan. Everything here is information, not investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Compare Microsoft's and Alphabet's operating margins and free cash flow over the last five years.
How fast are Apple's iPhone and Services revenue growing? Show the last eight quarters with sources.
Find companies with three-year revenue growth above 15%, net margins above 20% and ROIC above 20%.

positive.prompt: How fast are Apple's iPhone and Services revenue growing? Show the last eight quarters with sources.
positive.expected_behavior: A table of eight quarters for both lines with year-over-year growth and SEC filing links, and a link to dividenddata.com/stocks/AAPL/kpis.

positive.description: Five years of filed income statements
positive.prompt: Show Microsoft's revenue, operating income and net income for the last five fiscal years.
positive.expected_behavior: Five fiscal years from Microsoft's filed income statements with the fiscal-year labels, and a link to the Financials page. Either tool may answer.

positive.description: Screen stocks on growth, margin and ROIC
positive.prompt: Find companies with three-year revenue growth above 15%, net margins above 20% and ROIC above 20%.
positive.expected_behavior: A ranked list of matching companies with each screened value, the match count and a link to the same screen on dividenddata.com/screener.

positive.prompt: How safe is Verizon's dividend, and how has its payout ratio moved over five years?
positive.expected_behavior: Verizon's Dividend Safety grade with its factors, the current yield and payout ratios with their history, and a link to the Dividend page.

positive.description: Add two tickers to the watchlist
positive.prompt: Add Nvidia and Broadcom to my watchlist.
positive.expected_behavior: Both tickers are added to the account's primary watchlist and the answer confirms what was added (nothing is removed or changed).

negative.description: No tool trades; the assistant says it can't place trades.
negative.prompt: Buy 10 shares of Apple for me.
What's the weather in Chicago tomorrow?

negative.description: No tool removes anything; the assistant says removals are made on the site.
